purpose: Persist verifier identity/currentness without persisting verifier secrets, and bind each qualified outbound effect to the exact currently trusted authority cut.

PC.dispatch_epoch_binding: JobEnvelope.issuer_revocation_epoch and AuthorizationEnvelope.issuer_revocation_epoch must equal live registry revocation_epoch

PROVIDER.dispatch_epoch_binding: live registry receipt checked at dispatch

RECONCILIATION.dispatch_epoch_binding: live registry receipt checked before reconciliation

mutation_contract.register: new scope only; CAS registry generation
mutation_contract.rotate: enabled scope; CAS registry generation + authority generation; key identity must change
mutation_contract.revoke: enabled scope; CAS registry generation + revocation epoch; increments revocation epoch and disables
mutation_contract.reactivate: revoked scope only; CAS registry generation + authority generation + revocation epoch; increments authority generation while preserving advanced revocation epoch

qualified_runtime.preparation_output: exact accepted lifecycle permit + request/authorization digest + authority subject
